description: React component implementing a recommendation-driven 'Direct Trajectory' panel for career role suggestions, gap analysis, and roadmap visualization, with backend API calls for role recommendations.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Sanitizes and trims input to string.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts input to an array of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts role ID from role object using various possible fields.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts role title from role object.

methods.name: horizonWeeks
methods.description: Returns number of weeks based on time horizon ('Near', 'Mid', 'Far').

methods.name: horizonLabel
methods.description: Returns label string for given time horizon.

methods.name: intersectSet
methods.description: Finds intersection of two string arrays, case-insensitive.

methods.name: differenceSet
methods.description: Finds difference between required and have string arrays, case-insensitive.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Extracts unique skills from persona object across multiple schema fields.

methods.name: extractRequiredSkills
methods.description: Extracts required skills from role object.
